text:
maya: Kicking off release: llm-routing-v3. Multi-service change (api + worker). Follow the weighted ramp plan below. Pin model to 2026-03-21-v3 for this rollout. Window 22:00-23:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for service: api@v3, worker@v3. Canary instances: api-canary-2, worker-canary-1. Auto-rollback: enabled.

liam: I'll own telemetry. Watch these metrics: request latency p95, token throughput, error-rate 5xx. If p95 increases > 150ms or 5xx > 0.5% hold and alert.

arjun: Plan: ramp weights 0% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m. 10m between steps. If any step fails we hold and run rollback checklist.

maya: Agreed. Also note: we need to disable the legacy fallback route when at 50% to avoid double-routing.

sam: I'll do the flag toggles. Using devex CLI: ```rflag set --flag llm-routing-v3 --percent 10 --targets api,worker --note "canary step 1"``` Will post timestamps after each change.

deploy-bot: Canary green on api-canary-2 (health OK). worker-canary-1 shows elevated tail latency +20ms but within threshold.

arjun: Kicking step 1 now. sam, please set to 10% when ready.

sam: set to 10% -> done. CLI output: ```OK: flag llm-routing-v3 at 10% (api:10, worker:10) -- change_id=chg-20260321-01```

ops-monitor: No unusual error spikes in the first 3 minutes. p95 API = 120ms, worker p95 = 180ms (baseline 160ms).

liam: Good. Keep an eye on KV-cache hit rate and KV eviction logs. Routing v3 generates slightly different prefix distributions.

maya: If p95 stays < 150ms for API and 5xx < 0.5% for next 10m, move to 25%. Otherwise hold and triage.

deploy-bot: 10m elapsed. Telemetry snapshot: api p95 128ms, 5xx 0.12%, worker p95 175ms, worker 5xx 0.04%. Recommendation: advance.

sam: Increasing to 25% now. ```rflag set --flag llm-routing-v3 --percent 25 --note "ramp step 2"``` -> change_id=chg-20260321-02.

ops-monitor: Within 2m of step: small blip in tail for worker (p95 -> 200ms) but 5xx stayed low.

liam: I'm watching model token latency on node pool B. If it continues to trend up +50ms we should pause.

maya: Hold for 2m of observation. If it stabilizes, proceed to 50%. If not, revert to 0% and rollback services to api@v2/worker@v2 (rollback_id rb-20260321-01).

arjun: Agreed. Triage checklist if pause: capture flamegraphs, recent kernel logs, GPU queue latency, and kv-cache eviction metrics.

deploy-bot: 5m observation -> worker p95 trending back to 170ms, API stable. No increase in 5xx.

sam: Proceeding to 50% now. ```rflag set --flag llm-routing-v3 --percent 50 --note "final ramp"``` -> change_id=chg-20260321-03. Pin action: annotated pinned-model=2026-03-21-v3.

ops-monitor: Post-50% snapshot: api p95 135ms, worker p95 168ms, 5xx combined 0.11%. KV-cache hitrate ~92%. No alerts.

liam: Leave routing v3 enabled for 1h soak, but reduce background batch jobs on cluster B by 20% to keep headroom.

maya: Noted. sam, when you flip the legacy fallback, add a short note in release notes: "legacy-fallback disabled after successful ramp".

sam: Legacy fallback disabled -> done. release-note: "llm-routing-v3: 50% weighted rollout across api/worker, model pinned to 2026-03-21-v3. Legacy fallback disabled. Rollout monitored; soak in progress."

devex: Quick reminder for docs: update SDK routing guide to mention behavior differences at weight >=25% (cache warmup). Filing a doc ticket DOC-145.

maya: Thanks team. If anything degrades push into this thread and tag @maya @liam. If we need to rollback: use command ```deploy-bot rollback --id rb-20260321-01 --services api,worker``` and notify infra for capacity adjustments.

deploy-bot: Rollout marked as successful for initial ramp. Auto-rollback remains armed for 60m.

liam: All good from telemetry for now. Will update at +30m and +60m.

maya: Closing active ops for the window unless anyone reports issues. Great job. :tada:
